primary_claim: The probability of sampling a trained neural network at random from a Gaussian/uniform prior (its 'local volume') decreases exponentially as the network is trained and grows in complexity, and networks that memorize their training data without generalizing have lower local volume (higher complexity) than generalizing ones.
limitations_stated: the tyche estimator uses a quick-and-dirty volume estimation method that is very fast but can lead to dramatic underestimates of basin size
quote: We find that the probability of sampling a network at random— or local volume for short— decreases exponentially as the network is trained and grows in complexity.
